candidates.change_summary: Delete the require(msg.sender == Owner) check so anyone can call withdraw and drain the contract.
Invert the ownership check to require(msg.sender != Owner) so only non-owners can withdraw.
Change the transfer amount to zero so withdraw transfers no ether while passing the ownership check.
Remove the `require(msg.sender == Owner);` check so any address can execute arbitrary commands.
Replace the owner check with a check on tx.origin so it fails for direct owner calls not made via the deploying EOA.
Forward address(this).balance instead of msg.value, changing the ETH sent to the target contract.
Change the guard condition from '>=' to '>' so the transfer is skipped when msg.value equals the contract balance.
Transfer only msg.value instead of the full balance plus msg.value.
Delete the transfer statement so no funds are sent when the condition holds.
